pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal pretreatment at 120 °C and 2 atm for 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, and 70 minutes using an autoclave.
Aerobic biodegradability test using a respirometer with a thermostated bath and magnetically stirred flasks, monitoring oxygen content continuously via data acquisition system.

Anaerobic digestion in four 1-L Pyrex complete mixing digesters under mesophilic conditions with a 1:7 substrate:inoculum ratio, gradually increasing organic load from 0.50 to 1.00 g VS/L over 15 days, followed by a series of experiments with varying percentages of pretreated PP and EP.
Monitoring of parameters such as pH, TS, FS, VS, TOC, N-NH4 +, alkalinity, and VA in the effluents after each load of the anaerobic digesters.
Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis to evaluate structural changes in the raw materials and pretreated substrates.
